name: status

text: ROUND is a mobile group savings and commitment app. The submission demonstrates real Solana devnet transactions with test tokens. Source: ROUND application and contract in github.com/Oracle00999/round. No mainnet launch or independent audit is claimed.

name: title
text:
Friends can share a goal.
Holding the money is harder.
textPreview: Friends can share a goal. | Holding the money is harder.

name: left-body
text:
A goal is easy to postpone.
Progress stays invisible to the group.
textPreview: A goal is easy to postpone. | Progress stays invisible to the group.

name: right-body
text:
One person holds the funds
and coordinates everyone’s payout.

name: insight
text: ROUND pairs shared accountability with individual savings vaults.
textPreview: ROUND pairs shared accountability with individual savings vaults.

text: This is the product problem and design hypothesis, not a claim from a market survey. Initial use cases include friends saving for travel, devices and other planned expenses.

name: title

name: note
text: No rotating group payout. No member acts as treasurer.
textPreview: No rotating group payout. No member acts as treasurer.

text: Implementation: create_round fixes schedule and amounts; join_round creates member savings/bond vaults; withdraw checks the on-chain end time and member authority. No administrator withdrawal instruction is present in current code. Upgrade authority still exists, so this is not an immutability claim.

name: copy-3
text: Claim your savings and any bond after unlock. No group approval.
textPreview: Claim your savings and any bond after unlock. No group approval.

text: Actual app journey. Creating also joins the creator; USDC is paid separately after the start. Joining closes at the start. Each member can make one fixed contribution per period. The presentation uses a two-minute start delay and three-minute periods, with labelled edits across waiting times.

name: bond-2b
text:
Returned in full, even with missed
contributions. No slashing or yield.
textPreview: Returned in full, even with missed | contributions. No slashing or yield.

text: SKR bond is configured by the creator and is the same required amount for each member of that ROUND. The feature is optional at creation. Current deployment uses a custom devnet SKR test mint, not real mainnet SKR. This is a time lock, not staking and not yield.

text: Actual ROUND Home screen captured on the connected Seeker. Implemented with React Native / Expo, Mobile Wallet Adapter and local Android notifications. Alert delivery depends on permissions and Android scheduling. Seeker is the current tested wallet.

text: Evidence: latest successful 57-test run in .local/tests-mainnet.log includes 11 actual SBF integration tests. Phone success was confirmed by the user for creation and loading. Full two-account phone lifecycle and all notification delivery states remain validation work. Testing is not an independent security audit. Mainnet work is paused.
